python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys, random; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from warmcheck import brute_warmup
import gen, para, algo, topo
rng=random.Random(101)
bad=0; n=0
for it in range(400):
    K=rng.randint(1,4)
    prof=gen.gen_profile(rng,K,consistent=(rng.random()<0.9))
    cal=para.Calibration(prof)
    if not cal.feasible: continue
    fab=gen.gen_fabric(rng,K=K)
    plan=algo.compile_plan(prof,fab)
    if plan['guard_ns'] is None: continue
    n+=1
    F=topo.Fabric(fab,cal)
    g=plan['guard_ns']
    bw = brute_warmup(F, g, plan['pred'], plan['bounds_as'], plan['age_rounds'])
    if bw != plan['warmup_cycle']:
        bad+=1
        print('WARMUP MISMATCH brute=%s plan=%s'%(bw, plan['warmup_cycle']))
        if bad>2: break
print('checked',n,'warmup mismatches',bad)
EOF
